assetMetadata.imageAlt: Aggregate-demand multiplier graph with AD1, AD2, and AD3 shifting progressively right at a fixed price level P, corresponding to output levels Y1, Y2, and Y3.
assetMetadata.graphDescription: The horizontal axis is real output Y and the vertical axis is the price level P. A horizontal line at price level P crosses three downward-sloping aggregate-demand curves. AD1 intersects at output Y1, AD2 lies to the right and intersects at Y2, and AD3 lies farther right and intersects at Y3, so Y1 is less than Y2, which is less than Y3.

assetMetadata.imageAlt: AD-AS graph with LRAS at Y1, two aggregate-demand curves, two short-run aggregate-supply curves, and labeled output gaps.
assetMetadata.graphDescription: The horizontal axis is real output Y and the vertical axis is the price level. LRAS is vertical at Y1. AD1 and AD2 slope downward, with AD2 to the right of AD1. AS1 and AS2 slope upward, with AS1 above and left of AS2. Dashed guides mark Y3 left of LRAS, Y1 on LRAS, Y2 right of LRAS, and price levels P1, P2, and P3. AD1-AS2 is at Y1/P1; AD1-AS1 is at Y3/P2; AD2-AS2 is at Y2/P2; AD2-AS1 is at Y1/P3.

assetMetadata.imageAlt: Money-market graph with two vertical money-supply curves, two downward-sloping money-demand curves, and labeled interest-rate and money-quantity points.
assetMetadata.graphDescription: The vertical axis is interest rate r and the horizontal axis is quantity of money Qm. MS1 is vertical at Qm1 and MS2 is vertical to its right at Qm2. MD1 slopes downward through e at Qm1, r2 and g at Qm2, r1. MD2 is shifted right and upward and slopes downward through a at Qm1, r4 and d at Qm2, r3. Additional labeled points are b at Qm2, r4; c at Qm1, r3; and f at Qm1, r1.

assetMetadata.imageAlt: Two-panel monetary-transmission graph showing a leftward money-supply shift with a higher interest rate and a leftward aggregate-demand shift with lower output.
assetMetadata.graphDescription: The left panel has interest rate r on the vertical axis and money M on the horizontal axis. A downward-sloping MD curve intersects MS1 at r1; MS2 is left of MS1 and intersects MD at the higher rate r2. The right panel has price level P on the vertical axis and output Y on the horizontal axis. AD2 lies left of AD1. At price level P1, output is Y1 on AD1 and Y2 on AD2.
